text:
maya: FYI noticed a billing/alerting mismatch for tenant `beta-retail` after we enabled soft-rollout to v2. console shows v2 tokens ~0 but traces prove model responses are from v2.

neil: saw that too. looks like the per-route aggregator gets an `unknown_route` tag when the routing proxy strips `X-Client-Version` and then console mapping drops it.

arun: here's a sample from the runtime trace: 
```
2026-03-22T02:11:05Z decision: tenant=beta-retail selected=v2 fallback=true header.X-Client-Version=
2026-03-22T02:11:05Z emit_metric: route_key=unknown tokens=254
```
we treat `unknown` as a catch-all which isn't mapped to route buckets.

zara: product is worried about tenants getting surprised with quota surges on v1 while we're actually serving v2. also noisy alerts are spiking support.

maya: we need a safe short-term remediation that doesn't risk double-counting. ideas?

neil: my proposal: attach a stable `route_decision_id` to the request lifecycle at routing time and include that id in every telemetry emission. then a downstream aggregator can dedupe by decision_id for a 5s window. That prevents duplicates if retries cross boundaries.

arun: +1. we should also emit a `route_tag_hint` that records the chosen logical route (eg `v2`) even if original header missing. console can use `route_tag_hint` for bucket assignment. aggregator uses both route_tag_hint and decision_id for correctness.

zara: UX ask: add a small console note on tenant usage saying "compat-mode active: some route attribution is provisional" with link to docs. product wants an automated drift alert when attributed v1-v2 delta > 7% over 30m.

neil: implementation caveats: (1) decision_id must be globally unique per decision and stable across retries, (2) dedupe window configurable per pipeline, (3) we must avoid holding metrics until final model commit or we'll add latency. dedupe in aggregator is better than waiting upstream.

arun: aggregator-side dedupe is cheap if we use a bloom-filter + LRU cache keyed by decision_id. we already use a similar pattern for idempotent request dedupe.

maya: what about the case where unknown tag persists and we never fill route_tag_hint (eg legacy proxy strips everything)? then billing still fails. we should backfill for known tenants in a short rollout: if decision_id maps to a tenant with rollout flag on, just force route_tag_hint.=v2.

zara: product wants an explicit opt-in flag per tenant so they consent to forced attribution for a short forensics window. also log an event for audit trails.

neil: I'll draft a PR to: (A) add decision_id generation in routing layer, (B) add route_tag_hint, (C) surface decision_id in traces. aggregator change in separate PR to dedupe.

arun: I'll prototype aggregator dedupe and a console mapping that prefers route_tag_hint then falls back to decision_id mapping. also will ensure metrics emission doesn't block fast-path.

console-bot: ticket created CE-9012 "compat attribution: decision_id + hint + aggregator dedupe" assigned neil, arun.

deploy-bot: proposed rollout: staging canary 2026-03-22T10:00Z, prod canary 2026-03-22T11:30Z (monitor drift metric for 60m).

maya: timeline OK. follow-ups: neil opens PR, arun opens aggregator PR, zara adds console banner + drift alert config, ops to run canary and watch CE-9012. escalate if >10% drift persists.

neil: starting PR now, will link CE-9012.

zara: I'll update the docs link and prepare tenant communication copy.

maya: thanks all. if anyone spots other tenants with odd attribution, paste tenant id here.
